description: Genosm is a clinical-grade, local-first family systems, medical pedigree, and multi-modal case formulation platform built for therapists, genetic counselors, clinical researchers, and social workers. Combining a client-side PHI-redacting AI engine with strict McGoldrick, Hartman, and NSGC symbology, Genosm unifies 22 specialized clinical diagram modalities, ICD-10/DSM-5/OMIM/HPO diagnostic coding, longitudinal git-style version diffing, and an infinite spatial Case Conceptualizer within a HIPAA-ready, zero-knowledge environment.
name: Genosm
